context: Loop Assurance v3 is protected on main and exact-main is live on Netlify. The live five-minute controller now re-proves loop closure continuously and automatically includes newly registered loops.
root_cause: Previous assurance could prove scheduler/runtime activity without guaranteeing fresh evidence for every closed-loop stage.
Historical green state could therefore outlive the evidence that originally justified it.
fix: Require fresh stage evidence for input, decision, action, readback, outcome, measurement, learning and guard.
Keep incomplete loops non-green and materialize assurance obligations.
Use dynamic active registry membership so newly registered loops enter assurance automatically.
prevention_rules: Historical LIVE/GREEN is never reusable without fresh runtime/provider readback.
A new active loop is automatically governed by Loop Assurance.
Deployment truth and business/capability truth remain separate.
Terminal closure includes Brain learning, skill, agent/chat contract, ledger/docs and System Map read-after-write.

production_readback.assertion: The assurance controller is live, fail-closed and dynamically includes the current active loop registry.

evidence: Netlify current production deploy is ready on the exact main commit.
Live Supabase aggregate health returned 13 active loops with 2 GREEN, 11 AMBER and 0 RED.
Autonomous outreach and source-backed outbound both reported 8/8 fresh stages.
